SELECT "id", "creator_id", "creation_time", "modifier_id", "modification_time", "round_id", "turn_number", "agent_id", "agent_name", "agent_version", "status", "error_message", "start_time", "end_time", "llm_start_time", "llm_end_time", "request_id", "trace_id", "message_storage_mode", "request_messages_snapshot", "request_messages_snapshot_hash", "raw_request", "response_message_present", "response_content", "response_content_parts", "finish_reason", "usage_present", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", "total_tokens", "cached_prompt_tokens", "reasoning_tokens", "raw_response", "response_error_message", "reasoning_content" FROM "conversation_turn" WHERE "round_id" = #{roundId} ORDER BY "turn_number" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (round."round_number") round."round_number" AS "roundNumber", turn."response_content" AS "assistantAnswer" FROM "conversation_round" round INNER JOIN "conversation_turn" turn ON turn."round_id" = round."id" WHERE round."conversation_id" = #{conversationId} AND round."deleted" = FALSE AND turn."response_message_present" = TRUE AND BTRIM(turn."response_content") <> '' ORDER BY round."round_number", turn."turn_number" DESC
